n: The Westin Savannah Harbor Golf Resort & Spa
p:
>
Pet Policy
We offer a limited selection of pet-friendly guest rooms, and guests are welcome to bring a dog weighing up to 40 pounds. No other pets are permitted. A 50 USD non-refundable daily fee for dogs will be collected upon check-in. We are happy to provide a Heavenly® Dog Bed, a pet welcome kit, and food bowls with a mat. Room assignments are subject to floors designated as pet-friendly. Not all room types can accommodate a pet. Pets may not be left unattended in a guest room. Dogs (excluding service dogs) are not allowed in any food and beverage outlets (including the pool area, tennis courts, and golf course).
Career Opportunities
Ever dreamed of working in the hospitality industry?
Get your start at The Westin Savannah Harbor Golf Resort & Spa! We are always looking for friendly, motivated individuals to join our team.
